schema.text: In the evening or after dark, do you feel unsafe here from crime or harassment?
schema.help: Harassment means unwanted comments, gestures or contact. This question is about your own feeling, not about traffic.

en.#Harassment means unwanted comments, ges: Harassment means unwanted comments, gestures or contact. This question is about your own feeling, not about traffic.
en.#In the evening or after dark, do you fe: In the evening or after dark, do you feel unsafe here from crime or harassment?

it.#Harassment means unwanted comments, ges: Per molestie si intendono commenti, gesti o contatti indesiderati. La domanda riguarda la tua sensazione, non il traffico.
it.#In the evening or after dark, do you fe: Di sera o dopo il tramonto, qui ti senti in pericolo per reati o molestie?

fr.#Harassment means unwanted comments, ges: Le harcèlement désigne des commentaires, gestes ou contacts non désirés. Cette question porte sur votre ressenti, pas sur la circulation.
fr.#In the evening or after dark, do you fe: Le soir ou après la tombée de la nuit, te sens-tu en danger ici à cause de la criminalité ou du harcèlement ?

de.#Harassment means unwanted comments, ges: Belästigung bedeutet unerwünschte Bemerkungen, Gesten oder Berührungen. Diese Frage betrifft Ihr eigenes Gefühl, nicht den Verkehr.
de.#In the evening or after dark, do you fe: Fühlen Sie sich hier abends oder nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit wegen Kriminalität oder Belästigung unsicher?

tr.#Harassment means unwanted comments, ges: Taciz, istenmeyen söz, hareket veya temas demektir. Bu soru trafikle değil, kendi hissinizle ilgilidir.
tr.#In the evening or after dark, do you fe: Akşam veya hava karardıktan sonra burada suç veya taciz nedeniyle kendini güvensiz hissediyor musun?

fa.#Harassment means unwanted comments, ges: آزار یعنی سخنان، حرکات یا تماس ناخواسته. این پرسش دربارهٔ احساس خود شماست، نه ترافیک.
fa.#In the evening or after dark, do you fe: آیا عصرها یا پس از تاریکی در اینجا به دلیل جرم یا آزار احساس ناامنی می‌کنی؟

hu.#Harassment means unwanted comments, ges: Zaklatáson nem kívánt megjegyzéseket, gesztusokat vagy érintést értünk. Ez a kérdés az Ön saját érzésére vonatkozik, nem a forgalomra.
hu.#In the evening or after dark, do you fe: Este vagy sötétedés után bűncselekmények vagy zaklatás miatt veszélyben érzed magad itt?

ar.#Harassment means unwanted comments, ges: التحرش يعني تعليقات أو إيماءات أو لمسًا غير مرغوب فيه. يتعلق هذا السؤال بشعورك أنت، لا بحركة المرور.
ar.#In the evening or after dark, do you fe: هل تشعر هنا مساءً أو بعد حلول الظلام بعدم الأمان بسبب الجرائم أو المضايقات؟
